title: Map #300 · ship the woodwork
blurb: A ticket map as a call graph. Nodes are tickets, call edges are `blocked by`, effects are the durable artifacts a ticket deposits — a PR, a gate row, an ADR, a tracker edit — and the error channel is how the plan fails rather than how the code fails. The presets are histories: what happened, and the four things the map's own warnings say must not.

files.why: the inset constants, so the gate computes the 46 pairs from the numbers the renderer builds from
the sheet table, the UV rewrite, the per-member variation, the bind. Tickets 2–6 all land here — which is why they are a chain and not a fan-out
buildShelf and applySettings call the above and do no arithmetic of their own
the two materials keys, their defaults and their resolveSettings merge
the treatment. Numbers claimed at write time
the four questions 0080 closed by naming
regenerated in place — G13 pins that directory to exactly one file

⚠ must NOT be edited, and it is on the list for that reason. packages/site/src/shelf/**/*.ts is already a declared scope, and the mutate array derived from this file is hashed — the drift an edit causes is caught by nothing

steps.comment: Six implementation tickets, a linear chain, and the map's own destination ticket. Exactly one is takeable at a time.

t303.name: #303 — a drawn fibre, and a knob to dial it

steps.comment: The sheet's own normal map measured 0.000% at every rung on two different sheets. The drawn fibre adds 0.742% of frame level. Not an extra texture — a better use of one.

steps.comment: No gate row. The look is the owner's verdict, on a live build or on screenshots, never on a number.

t304.name: #304 — the backboard takes its own sheet

steps.comment: #297 measured all 41 veneers Poly Haven publishes; the darkness constraint leaves exactly one candidate, third-nearest 24.8 luma away. That is why it is a constant.

steps.comment: ?woodSeed pins the root so the render harness can force one; a fresh page draws a fresh root. The backboard's key must carry the root — its absence renders correctly and only misreports.
